snippet.title: Santiago Abascal en 'La Revuelta' de David Broncano
snippet.description:
La Revuelta cumple con los pronósticos y logra su programa más visto con Santiago Abascal. La entrevista de David Broncano al líder de Vox, que había elevado su ya gran expectación en la previa por el polémico veto de la formación ultraderechista al público habitual del programa de RTVE, registra un 33.6% de share y 4.815.000 espectadores.

Se trata de su récord histórico en televidentes, superando en 428.000 personas a la entrega del formato con Pedro Sánchez, que mantiene en su poder la mejor cuota histórica del espacio de La 1: 33.9% y 4.387.000 televidentes. La visita de Abascal al show de la pública se queda, por tanto, a tres décimas de la que obtuvo el presidente del Gobierno. Además, La Revuelta se bate a sí misma y obtiene de nuevo la emisión no deportiva más vista del año en televisión.

snippet.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy | BBC News
snippet.description:
US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.
 
The company, one of the most valuable in the world, says its board has no reason to believe Nvidia's secrets or national security were compromised.
 
US intelligence officials believe Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to the New York Times.
 
Huang has separately admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children.
 
US President Donald Trump says he has not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged.
 
"I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters late on Sunday, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country".

snippet.title: 소탕 작전에 궁지 몰린 아이티 갱단…악명 높은 두목 제거도 / 연합뉴스 (Yonhapnews)
snippet.description:
소탕 작전에 궁지 몰린 아이티 갱단…악명 높은 두목 제거도

    (서울=연합뉴스) 수천 명의 엘살바도르군과 유엔이 지원하는 갱단진압부대(GSF) 등이 투입된 아이티에서 악명 높은 갱단들이 사면초가에 내몰리고 있습니다.

    7일(현지시간) 도미니카공화국 매체 엘수소스와 AP통신 등에 따르면 전날 아이티 경찰은 수도 포르토프랭스의 빈민가 일대에서 합동작전을 벌여 악명 높은 '보스턴' 갱단의 두목 마티아스를 사살했습니다.

    알릭스 디디에 필스 아이메 아이티 임시 총리는 "갱단들은 편히 잘 수 없을 것"이라며 경고했습니다.

    이번 공세는 자국 군인 실종에 분노한 나이브 부켈레 엘살바도르 대통령이 2천여 명의 병력을 파병하고, 미 해군 특수부대 출신이자 블랙워터 창립자인 에릭 프린스가 이끄는 민간 군사기업까지 가세한 가운데 이뤄졌습니다. 

    실제로 한때 수도의 90% 이상을 장악하며 기세를 떨치던 갱단들은 최근 강력한 반격을 받고 동요하는 모양새입니다.

    아이티의 강력한 갱단 중 하나인 '400 마워조'는 최근 무장 갱단 해산을 담당하는 정부 기관에 연락을 취해 "평화와 안정을 위한 대화에 나서겠다"고 밝히기도 했습니다.

snippet.title: 🌸🪔 3 Stunning DIY Diwali Floral Rangoli & Candle Holder Ideas! ✨ #shorts #diycrafts #diwalidecor
snippet.description:
Want to give your home a beautiful festive makeover? Try these three creative DIY decoration ideas using fresh marigold flowers, colourful roses, recycled cans, and decorative diyas. These gorgeous designs will make your festive decor look truly royal! ❤️

1. 🌼 Beautiful Floral Border Rangoli
Create a stunning floral rangoli along the edge of your floor! First, place cardboard pieces along the wall to create a neat border and decorate them with fresh marigold flowers. Fill the centre with beautiful red roses and white flowers. Add decorative diyas and LED candles around the design to complete this elegant floral border rangoli!

2. ✨ DIY Golden Recycled Can Candle Holder
Turn an empty cold drink can into a luxurious candle holder! Clean and dry the can thoroughly, then apply golden spray paint in a well-ventilated area. Once completely dry, wrap different decorative lace designs around it. Place a suitable LED tealight on top to create a beautiful golden candle holder using recycled materials!

3. 🪷 Beautiful Diya & Lotus Floral Rangoli
Create a gorgeous floral rangoli with a traditional diya and lotus design! First, outline the diya and lotus patterns on the floor. Fill the designs with beautiful white, red, and yellow flower petals. Arrange the flowers neatly to make the patterns stand out, then add glowing LED diyas to complete this stunning festive decoration!

snippet.title: Global National: Nov. 8, 2026 | Canada honours CFB Wainwright victim Pte. Aidan Goulding
snippet.description:
A 23-year-old Canadian soldier is being remembered as a fearless, adventurous young man who found a sense of belonging in the Canadian Armed Forces. Pte. Aidan Goulding was laid to rest in Vancouver on Sunday, with full military honours.  He was one of four soldiers who died last month in a fast-moving fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright. Thirty-nine others were injured, and many remain in hospital. Sarah MacDonald has our top story on how Goulding is being honoured.

Each year on Nov. 8, the City of Toronto joins Canadians across the country in recognizing Indigenous Veterans Day. Attendees honour the service, sacrifice and contributions of First Nations, Métis and Inuit peoples to Canada’s military history. As Megan King reports, these veterans played a significant role in freedom fighting while facing systemic barriers and discrimination.
 
Poland has entered two days of mourning after a shooter killed six people on Saturday and wounded more than a dozen others. The suspected perpetrator is now in critical condition in hospital, and the Polish government has claimed he was influenced by 'far-right ideologies.' Heidi Petracek explains how the nation is grieving, and what's next for investigators.
 
Still reeling from his party's defeat last week during the U.S. midterm elections, President Donald Trump is now calling for Democratic lawmakers to be investigated by the Department of Justice (DOJ) — before power in Congress changes hands at the beginning of next year. Candice Cole has more from Washington.
 
A Haitian gang leader is calling on the UN to help negotiate peace — with a foreign government. It's a sign the gangs may be getting nervous, with El Salvador's president deploying thousands of soldiers to the country. As Mike Armstrong explains, what started as a rescue mission may be turning into a much bigger battle to break the gangs' grip on Haiti's streets. 
 
Prime Minister Mark Carney and Quebec Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon are trying to repair their working relationship after some recent tensions and having different visions for Canada's future. However, the two leaders do share a common bond, with both having played goalie for Oxford University's hockey team in the U.K. The leaders are among a long line of prominent Canadians who've laced up for the prestigious institution. In fact, the team still wears a red maple leaf.  Redmond Shannon has more.
